Name: Newly added Sebastian cutscene
Author: GiosaurusStardew
Description:
Note: This was supposed to be a test mod but since it was working nicely i decided to share it to you all!
___________

This mod Adds a new custom made heart event/cutscene for Sebastian! the purpose for this is to add more spice into the
Npc's and I believe Sebastian was a good start for me. You are free to give criticisms or point out what lacks in the event
or suggest on what I should do next!

-Requires Sebastian to have 8 hearts  (it will not replace the original 8 heart event)
-Can be triggered in any day and time! But I dont know if the event can repeat

Procedures:

-Replace SebastianRoom.xnb to your Content>Data>Events folder *as always be sure to backup your file if you find it inadequate*

Optional:
I added the sprites and portrait that I used. 
-The sprite replaces Sebastian's smoking into drinking soda making the cutscene more light!
